housing.summary: Geneva is one of Switzerland's most expensive rental markets. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 2,286/month per Numbeo (Aug 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need a valid passport or ID, proof of Swiss residence registration, and (for non-EU) a residence/work permit. Main banks in Geneva: UBS and Banque Cantonale de Genève (BCGE). PostFinance serves the whole country. Many banks offer English-language services in Geneva due to the international community.
required_docs: Proof of Swiss address registration (Attestation d'établissement)
Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)

schools.summary: Geneva has a dense network of international schools reflecting its role as a hub for UN and international organisations. Notable schools include Geneva International School (GIS), Institut Florimont, and the International School of Geneva (Ecolint), offering IB, French Baccalaureate, and other curricula.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Office cantonal de la population (OCP) in Geneva within 8 days of arrival (Geneva-specific rule, stricter than federal 14-day rule). EU/EFTA nationals receive permit B or L from the cantonal migration authority. Non-EU nationals need a permit from the Office cantonal de la population et des migrations (OCPM). Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: AHV-Nummer (OASI number) is the Swiss social insurance and tax reference number, assigned by the cantonal AVS compensation office (OCAS Genève) or employer. 13-digit format (756.XXXX.XXXX.XX). Geneva also has an income tax withholding system (impôt à la source) for foreign residents without a C-permit.

transport.summary: Geneva's public transport is operated by TPG (Transports Publics Genevois), offering trams, buses, and boats. A monthly city travel pass costs approximately CHF 75 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Service des automobiles et de la navigation (SAN) in Geneva; no test required. Mandatory Krankenversicherung/assurance-maladie must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Service des automobiles et de la navigation (SAN) Geneva; non-EU licences generally require a theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (assurance-maladie/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
